audited_files.notes: Strict bounds checking on BLE byte arrays (0x2AD2, 0x2A37) preventing index out-of-range exceptions.
Hardware safety ceiling (400W-450W default), progressive ramp limiter (max +20W/s) and 1-tap emergency stop (0W instant override).
Mandatory CCCD Indications on 0x2AD9, auto-re-unlock on 0x80 error 0x04, slope clamped to [-15%, +20%].
XML escaping (_escapeXml) applied to all user/route strings in Garmin TCX generator to prevent XML injection.
PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) enabled on profiles, ride_activities, and security_audit_logs. Server-side is_admin() check.
RBAC check enforced on setAdminSafetyMaxWattsCeiling with automatic CRITICAL audit log on unauthorized access.
Self-contained offline WebGL Three.js engine; no external CDN script loads, numeric sanitization on all JS bridge parameters.
Principle of least privilege: BLUETOOTH_SCAN (neverForLocation), BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.
